value.author: Rishabh
value.title: Absolutely Fantastic shall visit here.
value.text:
Our stay at this hotel was absolutely fantastic! The location was perfect, with easy access to transportation and a variety of amenities nearby. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The cleanliness of the property was impeccable, and the facilities provided exceeded our expectations. The WiFi was reliable, allowing us to stay connected throughout our stay. Some amazing restaurants nearby as well as the ones inside the hotel. The decorations were beautiful too for Christmas and overall vibe of the hotel was great. The hotel's walkability score was excellent, as we could easily explore the surrounding area on foot. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay in Mumbai.

value.author: Filip
value.title: Exceptional
value.text: Such an amazing place! As an European travelling solo, I was a little bit worried about where will I stay in Mumbai. I wasn't sure about all the locations, but I decided to stay and this hotel. It came out to be the best decision ever. It was literally the cleanest place I have seen in Mumbai. They also had all the amenities for European traveller, like toilet paper, coffee, English speaking staff, free bottled water. They offered me complimentary chai many times and I could order it via phone. The location was good, 10 minutes by Uber to the airport. The place was super clean, reception 24/7, staff was speaking English, there was a warm water, towel, soaps and shampoos provided. The staff was very helpful, they took me to the ATM and helped me with the pharmacy. The TV was working great and had Netflix and YouTube. The cleanliness was 100%, much better than in some European and American hotels. I was actually impressed. Bed was really comfortable. Thank you so much! If anu European or American traveller is reading this - that's the place to go, meets all the requirements!
